title: Doc2Harness: Benchmarking LLMs on Long-Horizon Harness Engineering of Coding Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.20344v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agents driven by large language models are increasingly deployed on long-horizon tasks, where they use tools and modify real workspaces. How well they perform depends as much on the harness around the model as on the model itself. Existing benchmarks measure downstream task success under a fixed harness, leaving harness engineering itself unexplored. We propose Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark that evaluates long-horizon harness engineering directly. In Stage 1, a build model operating inside a fixed builder harness receives an interface-only contract skeleton and a development document that consolidates behavior across twelve frontier harnesses, and then constructs a complete candidate harness in an isolated container. In Stage 2, the frozen candidate harness runs in containers separate from the construction environment, one per test case, and is driven end to end by a scripted mock model. translated_title: Doc2Harness：基于长时程工具框架工程任务的大语言模型编码智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 由大语言模型驱动的智能体正越来越多地被部署在长时程任务中，在这些任务里它们使用工具并修改真实的工作空间。其性能表现既取决于模型本身，也同等程度地取决于围绕模型的工具框架。现有基准测试在固定工具框架下衡量下游任务的成功率，而工具框架工程本身的研究仍是空白。我们提出 Doc2Harness，这是一个直接评估长时程工具框架工程能力的两阶段基准测试。在第一阶段，一个在固定构建器工具框架内运行的构建模型，接收一个仅含接口的契约骨架和一份整合了十二个前沿工具框架行为的开发文档，然后在一个隔离容器中构建出完整的候选工具框架。在第二阶段，冻结的候选工具框架在与构建环境相互隔离的容器中运行（每个测试用例一个容器），并由脚本化的模拟模型端到端地驱动。我们使用四个可观察指标对每个测试用例进行评分。
tldr: 该论文提出 Doc2Harness，一个两阶段基准测试，首次直接评估大语言模型为编码智能体进行长时程工具框架工程的能力，填补了现有基准仅能在固定框架下测试下游任务的空白。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Doc2Harness, a two-stage benchmark that directly evaluates LLMs' ability to perform long-horizon harness engineering for coding agents, filling a gap left by existing benchmarks that only measure downstream task success under a fixed harness.
